args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4. Bump the pin to 2.9.4, the fixed
version in the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (smallest fixed version within the 2.x line; 3.1.0 also fixes it but is a major-version jump)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**

## Review
- Requesting review from @alex (code owner) — merge to main requires code-owner approval per policy.
